 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Service tax:-**

 
 
• **It is a tax levied on the provision of services. It is a type of indirect tax.**
 
• It is paid by the consumer but collected by the service provider.
 
• Service tax is a source of tax revenue for the government.
 
 
 
• **Interest receipts:-**
 
 
• **These are earned when the government lends money to individuals or organizations. **
 
• Interest receipts are a type of non-tax revenue, meaning that they are not generated from taxes.
 
 
 
• **Sale of shares of PSUs:-**
 
 
• **It is the process of disinvesting the government's stake in public sector undertakings (PSUs). **
 
• The proceeds from the sale of PSU shares are a type of capital receipt, meaning that they are not used to meet current expenses.
 
 
 
• **Salaries and pension:-**
 
 
• **These are payments made to government employees and pensioners. **
 
• Salaries and pension are a type of revenue expenditure, meaning that they are used to meet the current expenses of the government.
